## Purpose

Describe the problem, proposed change, and affected specification or reference
implementation.

## Change type

- [ ] Normative standards text
- [ ] Informative documentation or example
- [ ] JSON Schema
- [ ] Reference implementation
- [ ] Conformance or regression test
- [ ] Governance, security, or legal notice
- [ ] Dated provider configuration

## Required checks

- [ ] I preserved the repository's Draft-for-Public-Comment status.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private M5POD evidence, confidential
      M5Canon material, personal data, or production endpoint details.
- [ ] I did not present a model, agent, wallet, credential, API, or internal
      classification as independent legal authority.
- [ ] I kept account context, asset/economic classification, and external legal
      status separate.
- [ ] Provider-specific claims cite dated primary sources and do not imply
      endorsement, enrollment, or credential issuance.
- [ ] Applicable examples validate against their schemas.
- [ ] Executable behavior has focused tests and the documented suite passes.
- [ ] Licensing, patent, and trademark effects are identified.
- [ ] Failure and revocation paths fail closed where authority, evidence,
      privacy, endpoint identity, or budget enforcement is uncertain.

## Evidence

List the exact validation commands, results, source dates, and any remaining
limitations.
